# Library

```{r}
#| label: library
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)

```

# Step 1
```{r}
#| label: import
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

nhis <- read_csv("nhis_flu_train_21_22.csv") |> 
  select(-c(HHX, SRVY_YR, AFNOW, PREGNOW_A, CVDDIAG_A, SHTFLU12M_A)) %>%
  filter(PHSTAT_A != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(across(-c(AGEP_A, PCNT18UPTC, PCNTLT18TC), as.factor),
         HEALTH = factor(PHSTAT_A, 
                         levels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent")) %>% as.integer) %>%
  select(-PHSTAT_A) %>%
  drop_na()

nhis_test <- read_csv("nhis_flu_predict_23.csv") |> 
  select(-c(HHX, SRVY_YR, AFNOW, PREGNOW_A, CVDDIAG_A)) %>%
  filter(PHSTAT_A != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(across(-c(AGEP_A, PCNT18UPTC, PCNTLT18TC), as.factor),
         HEALTH = factor(PHSTAT_A, 
                         levels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent")) %>% as.integer) %>%
  select(-PHSTAT_A) %>%
  drop_na()


```


# Step 2
```{r}
#| label: decision-tree
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)

dt_model <- rpart(
  HEALTH ~ .,
  data = nhis
)


rpart.plot(dt_model)

```


# Step 3
```{r}
#| label: conditional-inference-tree
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(partykit)

CIT_model <- ctree(
  HEALTH ~ .,
  control = ctree_control(maxdepth = 3),
  data = nhis
)

plot(CIT_model)

```

```{r}
#| label: CIT-predictions
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

CIT_pred <- predict(CIT_model, newdata = nhis_test)

```

```{r}
#| label: CIT-RMSE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

nhis_test_rmse <- nhis_test |> 
  mutate(HEALTH_CIT_pred = CIT_pred) |> 
  summarize(RMSE = sqrt(mean(HEALTH- HEALTH_CIT_pred)))

```

# Step 4
```{r}
#| label: KNN
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE

library(caret)

KNN <- knnreg(HEALTH ~ ., data = nhis)
nhis_small_test <- nhis_test %>% slice_sample(n = 1000)
preds_knn <- predict(KNN, newdata = nhis_small_test)

evalRMSE <- function(preds, test_data = nhis_test) {
  test_data %>% mutate(HEALTH_preds = preds) %>%
    summarize(RMSE = sqrt(mean((HEALTH - HEALTH_preds)^2)))  
}

evalRMSE(preds_knn, nhis_small_test)

```

# Step 5
```{r}
#| label: gam
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(gam)

GAM <- gam(HEALTH ~ s(AGEP_A), data = nhis)
preds_GAM <- predict(GAM, newdata = nhis_test)

evalRMSE(preds_GAM)

```


```{r}
#| label: gam-plot
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

nhis_test %>% select(AGEP_A, HEALTH) %>%
  mutate(preds_GAM = preds_GAM) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = jitter(AGEP_A), y = jitter(HEALTH)), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = AGEP_A, y = preds_GAM))

```
